block: suss: tree-sitter-ruby field name for a call's do...end block
parameters: suss: tree-sitter-ruby field name for a block's |x, y| parameter list
arguments: suss: tree-sitter-ruby field name for a call's own argument list
pair: suss: tree-sitter-ruby node type for a key: value or key => value argument
key: suss: tree-sitter-ruby field name for a pair node's key
value: suss: tree-sitter-ruby field name for a pair node's value
hash: suss: tree-sitter-ruby node type for a { key: value } literal
nil: suss: tree-sitter-ruby node type for Ruby's nil
t: Rails schema: the block parameter every create_table in a dump is written with
id: Rails schema: create_table option that sets or turns off the implicit key
primary_key: Rails schema: create_table option naming the key, column option marking one, and t.primary_key
type: Rails schema: the type key of an id: hash, and the type: option of t.references and t.virtual
integer: language: the tree-sitter-ruby node type for an integer literal, which the adapter reads; Rails' integer column type, and an id: type that draws on a sequence, is what the reader means
bigint: Rails schema: column type, the type of an implicit key and of t.references
serial: Rails schema: id: type for a four-byte key on a sequence
bigserial: Rails schema: id: type for an eight-byte key on a sequence
smallint: Postgres: the type t.integer limit: 2 creates
limit: Rails schema: column option giving an integer's width in bytes
polymorphic: Rails schema: t.references option that adds a _type column
foreign_key: Rails schema: t.references option and the t.foreign_key call
to_table: Rails schema: the table a foreign_key: hash points at
created_at: Rails schema: the first column t.timestamps creates
updated_at: Rails schema: the second column t.timestamps creates
datetime: Rails schema: the type of the columns t.timestamps creates
virtual: Rails schema: t.virtual, a generated column
column: Rails schema: t.column, and the add_foreign_key option naming the column
mysql: suss: storage system name for MySQL, which picks the SQL dialect
part: suss: word in the message about what the SQL grammar could not read
parts: suss: word in the message about what the SQL grammar could not read
library: suss: marker for a value a library states
exhaustive: suss: a storage contract that declares every field
dump: suss: storage contract origin for a dump of the database
